title: 李雷和韩梅梅
description:
Our New Game

Об игре* English support is AVAILABLE now! *

High School Odyssey is a campus simulation game full of tons of surprising interactive gameplay elements along the way. You are a high school student in the late 90s of China, and live in a big campus full of different girls and guys. Build up your character, try and get a date, try to get a girlfriend within 150 days!

High School Odyssey has a remarkably open design. Other than a few story elements, you are free to do what you want. The centerpiece of the game is the relationships that you can form with 23 characters. You need to slowly build their relationships through a variety of activities, including talking, dating, traveling, and other interesting things.

Ready to start a journey full of fun and surprise?FEATURES• Love System
You can have 9 girlfriends at the same time if you want.

• Gang System
Join a campus club or join the Mafia to be a gangster and dominate the campus. (Different choices of good and evil will lead to different game results.)

• Battle System
You can beat up anyone in the game, but of course it is not recommended to punch your little girlfriend.

• Campus System
If you don't do well on the exams, you'll be punished. If you get into too many fights, you'll also be expelled.
description_short: A campus simulation game full of tons of surprising interactive gameplay elements along the way.
